kafka_endpoint_id.description: Per-cluster Kafka REST endpoint ID (the pkc-* host prefix from the Confluent UI Cluster -> Overview -> REST endpoint, or extract from confluent.managed_kafka_clusters.clusters spec.http_endpoint).

region.description: Cloud region the cluster runs in, e.g. ap-southeast-2 (from the cluster spec.region).

cloud_provider.description: Cloud provider, lowercase: aws, gcp, or azure (from the cluster spec.cloud).
